interpretation: Paper construct/A-B shared-RCL numbering maps to the 424-residue supplied B sequence with +32 offset. Paper supports the R-A reference and different N-terminal context; this is not experimental measurement of a 32-residue signal-peptide cleavage. Full recombinant construct sequence is not explicitly reproduced in the paper text.
